F1: Post#cook` returns `raw` for `raw_html`, and `PollFeed` feeds unescaped, unsanitized feed HTML into it, which is rendered via `{{{cooked}}}` and `raw post.cooked`.
F2: topic_embed.rb:13` interpolates the URL into a single-quoted `href` with no escaping, guarded only by a `^https?` regex, and it also mutates the caller's string.
F3: Erubis trim mode emits `end if` followed by a newline (no `;`), so the next `@output_buffer.safe_append=` expression becomes the modifier condition and the template compiles; no SyntaxError.
F4: the item loop in `poll_feed.rb:31-37` has no rescue with `retry: false`, so one raising item blocks all later ones every run, and the check-then-insert in `import` can hit the unique index.
F5: PostCreator#create` returns the unsaved `@post` after a swallowed Rollback (e.g. host-spam), so `post.present?` passes and `TopicEmbed.create!` runs with nil ids against NOT NULL columns.
F6: the nil/nil case is unreachable (setting defaults to `''` and the controller rejects blank), as the finding itself concedes, and the rest is hardening with no concrete failure.
F7: start_with?('/')` matches `//host/path` and `sub(/^\/+/, '')` strips the slashes, so protocol-relative URLs are rewritten onto the source article's host (not the forum host, but the wrong host either way).
F8: discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` is a substring test, so any origin that is a substring of the forum URL passes the check.
F9: topic_id_for_embed` ignores trashed state while `TopicView#find_topic` hides deleted topics from non-staff, so the embed raises NotFound and the surviving mapping row prevents re-import.
F10: the importer now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote` with only the title, so the parsed thread `created_at` is unused, there is no category option, and each thread does an unrescued HTTP fetch (base version not diffed; inferred from current code).
F11: force: true` changes nothing in a normal migrate run; this is a migration-practice concern, not a behaviour defect.
